ns2:course.label: Intro Tchg Elem Age Children
ns2:course.description: (C & I 305) Course examines the contexts of elementary education in the public schools. Includes content on teaching as a profession and community/family contexts of education. Coursework is integrated with field experiences with elementary children. (EDPR 250) Requires concurrent enrollment in EDPR 250, section ELE. Prerequisite: EPS 201; EPSY 236; admission to the Elementary Teacher Education Program.
